title: Flux 2 Edit
description: Image-to-image editing with FLUX.2 [dev] from Black Forest Labs. Precise modifications using natural language descriptions and hex color control.

pricing.text: Requests cost $0.012 per megapixel of input and output. Input images will be resized to 1MP. For example, a 1024x1024 generation with 512*512 size image input will cost 0.024 (1 MP input + 1 MP output, each costing 0.012).

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.tooltip: The prompt to edit the image.

inputs.name: guidance_scale
inputs.tooltip: Guidance Scale is a measure of how close you want the model to stick to your prompt when looking for a related image to show you.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.tooltip: The seed to use for the generation. If not provided, a random seed will be used. -1 leaves it to the model.

inputs.name: num_inference_steps
inputs.tooltip: The number of inference steps to perform.

inputs.name: image_size
inputs.tooltip: The size of the image to generate. The width and height must be between 512 and 2048 pixels. 'custom' uses the width and height below.

inputs.name: num_images
inputs.tooltip: The number of images to generate.

inputs.name: acceleration
inputs.tooltip: The acceleration level to use for the image generation.

inputs.name: enable_prompt_expansion
inputs.tooltip: If set to true, the prompt will be expanded for better results.

inputs.name: enable_safety_checker
inputs.tooltip: If set to true, the safety checker will be enabled. Disabling it requires account authorization; unauthorized requests are always checked, and images flagged as unsafe are returned as black images.

inputs.name: output_format
inputs.tooltip: The format of the generated image.

inputs.name: image
inputs.tooltip: The URLs of the images for editing. A maximum of 4 images are allowed, if more are provided, only the first 4 will be used. Each socket may carry a batch; they are sent in socket order (the first picture of socket 1 is number 1).

omitted.why: yes/no sync_mode returns the file inline and drops it from fal's request history - always left off
